basis: The y-axis is labeled 'Pumping volume (m3)' with ticks at 10,000 to 40,000. The May bar is visibly the shortest, with a top just above the x-axis and well below the 10,000 tick (estimated ~800 m3), while the other five months (Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar) range from ~17,500 to 40,000 m3. May is therefore an isolated, extreme low-pumping value relative to the rest of the displayed cycle, matching the 'critical low-pumping anomaly' route rather than a routine low-pumping follow-up. No explicit numeric threshold is printed, so the routing rests on the clear visual disparity; 'background monthly record filing' is not supported because the value is an outlier, not a normal monthly entry.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-pumping anomaly review
